theme.en: Export Curbs Reshape Chip Supply and Investment Priorities
theme.zh: 出口管制重塑芯片供应与投资重点

dek.en: TSMC tightens China AI chip restrictions as US export approvals face scrutiny and new controls reach Malaysia and Singapore. Diverging DRAM and NAND outlooks, power constraints and stacked-memory inference chips show how unevenly AI demand translates into infrastructure spending.
dek.zh: 台积电收紧对中国AI芯片的限制，美国出口许可受到审视，新的管制涉及马来西亚和新加坡。DRAM与NAND前景分化、电力约束以及采用堆叠存储的推理芯片，显示AI需求向基础设施投资的传导并不同步。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AI Data Center Power Demand Is Forecast to Double by 2030
title.zh: AI数据中心电力需求预计到2030年翻倍

summary.en: Tom's Hardware reports that AI data center power demand is forecast to double by 2030 alongside $4 trillion in spending, citing an IEA report. Electricity generation and distribution are barely keeping pace with data center growth. For accelerator deployments, this makes power availability an infrastructure constraint alongside chip supply; the figures describe a forecast rather than installed capacity today.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware援引国际能源署报告称，伴随4万亿美元投入，AI数据中心的电力需求预计到2030年翻倍。发电与输配电建设的速度已难以跟上数据中心扩张。对加速器部署而言，电力可用性因此成为芯片供应之外的另一项基础设施约束；这些数字属于预测，并非当前已建成的容量。

title.en: AMD Zen 6 Desktop Launch Reportedly Slips After N2X Process Switch
title.zh: AMD Zen 6桌面处理器据报因转向N2X工艺而推迟

summary.en: Wccftech reports that AMD's Zen 6 Olympic Ridge desktop CPUs may arrive after Computex 2027 following a switch to TSMC's performance-focused N2X 2nm process. The report points to a possible second-half 2027 introduction and a delay of several months. The claimed change links the product schedule to process selection, but remains an unconfirmed roadmap report.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，AMD Zen 6 Olympic Ridge桌面处理器在转向台积电偏重性能的N2X 2nm工艺后，可能推迟至Computex 2027之后推出。报道指向2027年下半年发布的可能性，意味着数月的延期。这一说法将产品进度与工艺选择联系起来，但仍属于未经确认的路线图消息。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Tightens China AI Chip Curbs as US Rules Close Manufacturing Loophole
title.zh: 美国新规封堵制造环节漏洞，台积电收紧中国AI芯片限制

summary.en: Reuters reports, citing sources, that TSMC is tightening restrictions on China AI chips as new US rules close a manufacturing loophole. The reported change makes foundry access a direct channel through which export controls can affect chip designers. The supplied excerpt does not specify affected customers or quantify the production impact.
summary.zh: 路透社援引消息人士称，随着美国新规封堵制造环节的漏洞，台积电正在收紧针对中国AI芯片的限制。这一变化使晶圆代工服务成为出口管制直接影响芯片设计公司的传导渠道。所提供的摘要未列出受影响客户，也未量化生产影响。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储芯片

title.en: NAND Prices Face Pressure as Chinese Cloud Companies Cut SSD Orders
title.zh: 中国云厂商削减SSD订单，NAND价格面临下行压力

summary.en: The Register reports that Chinese cloud companies are cutting SSD orders, while TrendForce expects NAND supply to outpace demand in 2027. The outlook points to downward pressure on flash prices even as DRAM remains constrained. Buyers therefore face different supply conditions across storage and working memory rather than one uniform memory shortage.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，中国云厂商正在削减SSD订单，TrendForce预计2027年NAND供给将超过需求。这意味着闪存价格面临下行压力，而DRAM供应仍然偏紧。采购方因此需要分别判断存储与运行内存的供需状况，不能用同一种短缺逻辑看待整个存储市场。

title.en: KB Securities Forecasts 40% Rise in 2027 DRAM Contract Prices
title.zh: KB证券预测2027年DRAM合约价上涨40%

summary.en: BigGo Finance reports that KB Securities forecasts a 40% rise in 2027 DRAM contract prices in its outlook for Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. Such an increase would support memory suppliers' pricing while raising costs for system buyers. This is a brokerage forecast, not a confirmed contract-price increase or company guidance.
summary.zh: 据BigGo Finance报道，KB证券在三星电子与SK海力士的展望中，预测2027年DRAM合约价上涨40%。如果这一涨幅兑现，将支撑存储供应商的定价，同时提高系统采购方的成本。这属于券商预测，并非已确认的合约涨价或公司业绩指引。

title.en: AI Demand Raises the Cost and Risk of Memory R&D
title.zh: AI需求抬高存储研发的成本与风险

summary.en: EE Times examines how AI is reshaping memory makers' research priorities and encouraging partnerships to share development costs and risks. The discussion extends beyond the next process node to longer-term memory technologies. It highlights research collaboration as part of the industry's supply response, without announcing a specific new production ramp.
summary.zh: EE Times分析了AI如何重塑存储厂商的研发重点，并推动企业通过合作分担开发成本与风险。讨论范围超出了下一代工艺节点，延伸至更长期的存储技术。文章凸显了研发合作在行业供给应对中的作用，但并未宣布某项具体的新产线爬坡计划。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Penn State Unveils New Semiconductor Research Capabilities
title.zh: 宾州州立大学公布新增半导体研究能力

summary.en: Semiconductor Today reports that Penn State has unveiled new semiconductor research capabilities. The development adds an academic infrastructure item to the semiconductor R&D pipeline. The supplied excerpt does not identify the equipment, investment amount or access arrangements, limiting assessment of its manufacturing relevance.
summary.zh: 据Semiconductor Today报道，宾州州立大学公布了新增的半导体研究能力。这为半导体研发体系增添了一项高校基础设施进展。所提供的摘要未说明具体设备、投资金额或使用安排，因此尚难判断其对制造环节的实际作用。

title.en: Policy & Export Controls
title.zh: 政策与出口管制

title.en: Rep. Mast Says Commerce Approved More Than 879,000 AI Chips for Chinese Companies
title.zh: 美国议员Mast称商务部批准向中国企业销售逾87.9万颗AI芯片

summary.en: CNBC reports that Rep. Mast says the Commerce Department approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies. The disclosed figure puts the scale of export licensing at the center of scrutiny over US chip controls. Approvals alone do not establish how many chips were shipped, and the supplied excerpt does not give the approval period or product breakdown.
summary.zh: 据CNBC报道，美国众议员Mast称，商务部批准向中国企业销售超过87.9万颗AI芯片。这一披露使出口许可的规模成为审视美国芯片管制的重要焦点。获得批准并不等于芯片已实际交付，所提供的摘要也未说明批准的时间范围或产品构成。

title.en: US Advanced-Chip Export Controls Covering Malaysia and Singapore Take Effect
title.zh: 涉及马来西亚与新加坡的美国先进芯片出口管制生效

summary.en: The Edge Malaysia reports that new US export controls covering advanced chips and Malaysia and Singapore take effect on November 19. The development puts Southeast Asian supply routes into the compliance picture alongside direct China shipments. The supplied excerpt does not detail licensing thresholds or exemptions, so it does not establish a blanket shipment ban.
summary.zh: 据The Edge Malaysia报道，涉及马来西亚与新加坡的美国先进芯片出口新管制于11月19日生效。这使东南亚供应路径与直接对华出货一道进入合规考量。所提供的摘要未说明许可门槛或豁免条款，不能据此认定所有相关出货均被禁止。

title.en: Earnings & Outlook
title.zh: 业绩与展望

title.en: MELCON Operating Profit Is Forecast to Rise 38% as EUV Adoption Expands
title.zh: 受益于EUV应用扩大，MELCON营业利润预计增长38%

summary.en: Financial News reports a forecast for MELCON's operating profit to rise 38% this year, linking the outlook to the shift toward EUV. The report points to potential earnings benefits for suppliers exposed to lithography transitions. The figure is a forecast rather than a reported result, and the supplied excerpt does not identify its author or underlying order assumptions.
summary.zh: 韩国Financial News报道，MELCON今年营业利润预计增长38%，并将这一展望与向EUV转型联系起来。这表明光刻技术转换可能为相关供应商带来盈利机会。该数字属于预测，而非已公布的业绩；所提供的摘要未说明预测主体及其订单假设。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新芯片

title.en: d-Matrix Raptor Uses Stacked 3D DRAM to Address Inference Memory Limits
title.zh: d-Matrix Raptor采用堆叠3D DRAM应对推理存储瓶颈

summary.en: SiliconANGLE reports that d-Matrix's Raptor chip stacks 3D DRAM to address memory limits in inference. The design places memory integration at the center of an alternative AI accelerator's approach to serving models. The supplied excerpt provides no capacity, bandwidth or benchmark figures with which to assess the claimed benefit.
summary.zh: 据SiliconANGLE报道，d-Matrix的Raptor芯片采用堆叠3D DRAM，以应对推理中的存储瓶颈。该设计将存储集成置于替代性AI加速器服务模型的技术路径核心。所提供的摘要未给出容量、带宽或基准测试数字，尚无法量化其收益。

theme.en: Efficiency Depends on Scheduling, Precision and Memory
theme.zh: 效率取决于调度、精度与存储

dek.en: Eight preprints examine production inference dispatch, edge learning, hybrid attention, quantization verification and local engineering agents. Reported gains range from fewer H100s in a production A/B test to tighter error bounds, with benchmark scope and deployment assumptions kept explicit.
dek.zh: 本期8篇预印本涵盖生产推理调度、边缘学习、混合注意力、量化验证及本地工程智能体。研究结果从生产A/B测试中减少H100用量，到收紧量化误差边界；摘要保留各自的评测范围与部署条件。

title.en: Edge Accelerators & Learning Systems
title.zh: 边缘加速器与学习系统

title.en: Hypnos Splits Edge Continual Learning Between a RISC-V Device and a Smart Charger
title.zh: Hypnos将边缘持续学习分配给RISC-V设备与智能充电器

papers.authors: Guilherme Guedes, Marco Apolinario Lainez, Charlotte Frenkel

summary.en: Hypnos separates continual learning into a wake phase on a small RISC-V MCU-based system and a sleep phase on a smart charger. The device performs inference and lightweight gradient-free prototype updates, while the charger uses rehearsal-based gradient updates when power and memory budgets are larger. This partition targets adaptation without placing full backpropagation on the edge device; the supplied abstract mentions a ZCU104 FPGA deployment but ends before quantitative results.
summary.zh: Hypnos将持续学习分为两个阶段：由基于RISC-V MCU的小型系统承担清醒阶段，由智能充电器承担睡眠阶段。设备负责推理和轻量级无梯度原型更新，充电器则在电力与内存预算更充足时，通过样本回放进行梯度更新。这种划分旨在实现在线适应，同时避免在边缘设备上执行完整反向传播；所提供的摘要提及ZCU104 FPGA部署，但在量化结果之前已被截断。

title.en: Inference Systems, Models & Quantization
title.zh: 推理系统、模型与量化

title.en: Cap-and-Track Adapts Inference Dispatch to Changing Backend Capacity
title.zh: Cap-and-Track让推理请求分发适应后端容量变化

papers.authors: Benjamin Novotny, Doug Szeto, Chang Wang, et al.

summary.en: Cap-and-Track uses fast admission refusals to track available inference capacity, holding excess and retried work in durable priority queues outside execution. In a concurrent production A/B test at Meta, the traffic shaper served a classifier on 43% fewer H100s than its queued, fixed-rate predecessor, while lower-priority work waited longer during backfill peaks. Real-engine replay at steady capacity put goodput within 1% of a fixed rate tuned above measured capacity. The production result concerns asynchronous classifier serving rather than a general reduction in interactive LLM hardware needs.
summary.zh: Cap-and-Track利用快速准入拒绝信号追踪可用推理容量，将超额任务及待重试任务保存在执行路径之外的持久化优先队列中。在Meta的同期生产A/B测试中，该流量整形器运行一个分类器时，比采用队列与固定分发速率的前代方案少用43%的H100，但低优先级任务在回填高峰时等待更久。在稳定容量下的真实引擎回放中，其有效吞吐与调至高于实测容量的固定速率方案相差不到1%。生产结果针对异步分类服务，不能直接推广为交互式大模型所需硬件的普遍降幅。

title.en: FlashMorph2 Selects Hybrid Attention Layers Under the Recovery Objective
title.zh: FlashMorph2按恢复训练目标选择混合注意力层

papers.authors: Disen Lan, Xuanda Wang, Jianbin Zheng, et al.

summary.en: FlashMorph2 converts pretrained Transformers into hybrid full- and linear-attention models by evaluating discrete architectures on their own hidden states and jointly updating layer-selection scores and weights. Across tested Qwen3 scales and linear-attention variants, average scores improve over FlashMorph by 2.42 points on RULER, 1.08 on LongBench and 0.76 on recall-intensive tasks. Layer selection takes 0.72–3.57 GPU-hours for 0.6B–8B models. These results address selection quality and cost; the supplied excerpt does not give an end-to-end serving speedup.
summary.zh: FlashMorph2通过使用离散架构自身产生的隐藏状态进行评估，并联合更新层选择分数与权重，将预训练Transformer转换为结合完整注意力和线性注意力的模型。在所测试的Qwen3规模与线性注意力变体上，相比FlashMorph，RULER、LongBench及高召回需求任务的平均分分别提高2.42、1.08和0.76分。对于6亿至80亿参数模型，层选择耗时为0.72至3.57 GPU小时。这些结果针对选择质量与成本，所提供的摘要尚未给出端到端推理服务加速比。

title.en: Zonotopic Analysis Tightens Quantized-Network Error Bounds
title.zh: Zonotope分析收紧量化神经网络误差边界

papers.authors: Robert Debbas, Éric Goubault, Sylvie Putot

summary.en: This work verifies quantized ReLU networks with a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework that handles rounding and clamping jointly. On ACAS Xu at the two smallest tested perturbation radii, constrained zonotopes reduce average error-bound widths by about 70–85% and runtimes by 65–80% relative to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation. Plain zonotopes produce competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average. Gains vary with bitwidth, and symbolic DRA yields tighter bounds at larger radii, making the method's advantage regime-dependent.
summary.zh: 研究提出基于zonotope（带状多面体）的抽象解释框架，联合处理舍入与截断，以验证量化ReLU网络。在ACAS Xu基准的两个最小测试扰动半径下，相比QEBVerif的符号DRA传播，约束zonotope将平均误差边界宽度缩小约70%至85%，运行时间减少65%至80%。普通zonotope方法也能给出有竞争力的可靠边界，平均速度接近快300倍。收益随位宽而变化，较大扰动半径下符号DRA的边界更紧，因此优势取决于具体参数区间。

title.en: Clover Combines MoE Diffusion Generation with Recurrent Context Memory
title.zh: Clover结合MoE扩散生成与循环上下文记忆

summary.en: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is a diffusion language model with 35B total parameters and 3B activated parameters, combining recurrent memory for prior context with bidirectional attention inside each generated block. The authors report scores of 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, generation reaches a reported 680 tokens/s on one Nvidia GB300 at BF16 and batch size one. That throughput is tied to the stated internal workload and does not establish performance across serving conditions.
summary.zh: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview是一款总参数350亿、激活参数30亿的扩散语言模型，将历史上下文的循环记忆与当前生成块内的双向注意力结合。作者报告，其SWE-bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2.1得分分别为73.6和51.7。在内部智能体负载上，单颗英伟达GB300以BF16精度、批量大小为1运行时，报告的生成速度达到每秒680个词元。该吞吐对应指定的内部负载，不能据此判断各种服务条件下的表现。

title.en: GateWatch Uses Compact Boolean Rules for LLM Activation Monitoring
title.zh: GateWatch以紧凑布尔规则监测大模型激活

summary.en: GateWatch expresses activation-monitor decisions as Boolean logic over a small set of binarized sparse-autoencoder features. GateWatchServe computes only selected features, streams binary values across layers and evaluates probes through compact lookup tables. Across 24 Gemma-2-9B tasks, the authors report 80.49% mean test accuracy with averages of 3.8 features and 3.5 logic gates per probe. The compact rule size is promising for monitoring cost, but the supplied excerpt does not quantify end-to-end inference overhead.
summary.zh: GateWatch将激活监测器的决策表示为少量二值化稀疏自编码器特征上的布尔逻辑。GateWatchServe只计算选中的特征，跨层流式传递二值结果，并通过紧凑查找表评估探针。在Gemma-2-9B的24项任务上，作者报告平均测试准确率为80.49%，每个探针平均仅使用3.8个特征与3.5个逻辑门。紧凑规则有助于降低监测成本，但所提供的摘要尚未量化端到端推理开销。

title.en: Engineering Automation & Simulation
title.zh: 工程自动化与仿真

title.en: Local AI Agents Measure the Deployment Costs of Power Electronics Simulation
title.zh: 本地AI智能体评估电力电子仿真的部署成本

papers.authors: Yuzhuo Li, Pasan Gunawardena, Yunwei Li

summary.en: This paper presents an evaluation framework for locally hosted AI agents that build, run, measure and revise power electronics simulations. It treats power, energy, token use and elapsed time as deployment costs, extending assessment beyond whether an agent completes a design task. The approach is relevant when engineering data and licensed simulators must remain on site. The supplied abstract is truncated before numerical comparisons, so it does not support a specific cost or efficiency claim.
summary.zh: 论文提出评估框架，研究由本地部署AI智能体构建、运行、测量和修改电力电子仿真的流程。它将功率、能耗、词元用量与耗时纳入部署成本，评价范围超出了智能体能否完成设计任务。对于工程数据和授权仿真软件必须留在本地的场景，这种方法具有实际意义。所提供的摘要在数值对比之前已被截断，因此无法支持具体的成本或效率结论。

title.en: Quantum & Hybrid Learning
title.zh: 量子与混合学习

title.en: Soft-MoQE Learns to Combine Fixed Quantum Feature Maps
title.zh: Soft-MoQE学习组合固定量子特征映射

papers.authors: Valeria Repetto, Romina D'Aurizio, Piero Farinelli

summary.en: Soft-MoQE replaces trainable quantum circuits with a pool of fixed quantum feature maps combined by an input-dependent classical gating network. On three PCA-reduced MNIST and FashionMNIST tasks, it outperforms the best individual expert, uniform expert averaging and a linear baseline, while reaching task-dependent performance comparable to a trainable quantum neural network. This avoids optimizing quantum parameters and targets the cost and optimization difficulties of variational training. The supplied results do not establish quantum advantage over strong classical models or performance on unreduced datasets.
summary.zh: Soft-MoQE用一组固定量子特征映射替代可训练量子电路，再由依赖输入的经典门控网络组合这些映射。在经过PCA降维的3项MNIST与FashionMNIST任务上，它优于最佳单个专家、专家均匀平均和线性基线，并在部分任务中达到与可训练量子神经网络相当的表现。该方法无需优化量子参数，针对变分训练的成本与优化困难。现有结果尚不能证明其相对强经典模型的量子优势，也不能说明在未降维数据集上的表现。
